name: save-toggle
title: Save toggle
description: A save button that shrinks into a spinner, then pops a check when the save is done.

props.name: saved
props.description: Whether the item is saved; the button shows `savedLabel` and is pressed.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Runs the save. The button spins until it settles; a rejection puts it back.

props.name: onUnsave
props.description: Called when the button is pressed while `saved` is true.

props.name: label
props.description: Text on the button while the item is not saved.

props.name: savedLabel
props.description: Text on the button once saved; also announced when a save finishes.

props.name: savingLabel
props.description: Spoken name of the button while the save runs and the spinner shows.

a11y.text: It is a native button. A press while saving or just after is ignored, a press while saved calls onUnsave, and a rejected onSave puts it back to idle.

The button sets aria-pressed from saved and aria-busy while saving. It always has a name: the spinner carries savingLabel (default Saving) and the check carries savedLabel as screen-reader-only text. When the save finishes, a persistent status region next to the button says savedLabel. The icons are aria-hidden.
The spinner stops under reduced motion, the press scale and colour transition are off, and the component is wrapped in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user.
